verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that https://developer.brex.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured table of contents for the Brex Developer API. The developer docs are also served as markdown (.md) pages, including dedicated MCP docs aimed at AI assistants, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content agent bundle, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (all probed paths 404), and no independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs.
